name: Akamai Technologies, Inc
moat_justification: World's most distributed edge network and a $2.4B/yr security franchise growing 10%, but returns are converging to the cost of capital: ROIC proxy fell from 17.9% (2021) to 10.5% (2024-25) and gross margin has eroded six straight years (64.6% to 58.9%) as delivery commoditizes and lower-margin compute mix rises. The network is a real asset; the pricing power on it is not proven anymore.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.9%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Real network, eroding returns, moat 5/10 — mid-pivot into a capital-heavy AI-cloud bet; at $87.81 the weighted IRR is 6.9% on the TTM base (8.7% on the median base), IV@15% $29-42, so it clears 15% only below ~$29-42: Tier D.
moat_for: Most distributed edge network in the industry (4,100+ PoPs, ISP-embedded) — expensive and slow to replicate, best-in-class for large live-event delivery
Security franchise at scale: $604M in Q2 2026, +10% YoY, led by Guardicore segmentation and API security
Deeply embedded enterprise base with high retention; delivery cash flows fund the pivot
Contracted AI-cloud backlog: $14.4B of multiyear CIS commitments signed in 2026, incl. Anthropic $11.6B/7yr — multi-year revenue visibility peers lack
moat_against: Delivery (36% of Q2 revenue) declining -6% YoY against Cloudflare and hyperscaler bundling — the legacy moat is melting
ROIC proxy 17.9% (2021) → 10.5% (2025) and gross margin down ~1pp/yr for six years — measured returns no longer clear a wide-moat bar
No owned demand surface and weak developer mindshare vs Cloudflare
Anthropic pivot concentrates counterparty risk and demands ~$5.5B capex at unproven returns; warrant dilutes holders up to ~5%
